main.description: Builds an ordered feed skeleton from current indexed records for the registered feed and parameters selected in the request. Authentication is not required. The caller hydrates returned AT-URIs separately.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request is malformed or semantically invalid.

errors.name: UnsupportedFeed
errors.description: The requested feed identifier is not registered by this service.

errors.name: TrustedEvaluatorsTooLarge
errors.description: The trusted evaluator filter exceeds its supported size.

errors.name: InvalidKind
errors.description: The request contains an unsupported event kind.

errors.name: InvalidCursor
errors.description: The cursor is invalid or incompatible.

errors.name: InternalError
errors.description: The service encountered an internal error.

feedId.description: Identifier of the feed algorithm to execute.

params.description: Algorithm-specific parameters. Omit when the selected feed accepts none.

limit.description: Maximum number of feed subjects to return. The selected feed determines the default and may enforce a lower maximum.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous request for this feed.

schema.description: Returns ordered, unhydrated feed subjects and an optional cursor for the next page.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omitted when no later page is known.

feedSkeletonItem.description: One unhydrated record selected for the feed.

subject.description: AT-URI of the record to hydrate.
